Documentation & CLI Guide 📖

Get started with Cluster-SSG in seconds.

CLI Commands

# Build the entire static site into dist/
cluster-ssg build

# Start the preview development server on localhost:3000
cluster-ssg serve

# Start development server with binary wire security
cluster-ssg serve --binary

# Pack a .cld document into a .clb binary bundle
cluster-ssg pack site/pages/index.cld dist/index.clb

# Unpack a .clb binary bundle back to human-readable .cld
cluster-ssg unpack dist/index.clb site/pages/reconstructed.cld

# Run the Hugo-speed in-memory benchmark (1,000 pages)
cluster-ssg bench

The .cld Document Format

Each .cld file contains a structured header followed by the === splitter:

title: My First Article
author: Jane Doe
date: 2026-11-15
layout: post
tags: cluster,web,tutorial
description: A quick start guide.
===

Component Islands & Partial Hydration

Cluster-SSG supports 4 client hydration directives:

  • client:load - Hydrates immediately on page load
  • client:idle - Hydrates when browser enters idle state
  • client:visible - Hydrates when the element enters viewport
  • client:zero-js - Renders statically with zero client-side JavaScript
